name: Thai Basil Beef with Rice and Egg

components.name: Basil Beef

ingredients.name: Holy basil or regular basil leaves (1¼ cups)

steps: Pound or finely mince garlic and chilli. Slice the capsicum and remove basil leaves from the stems.
Heat oil in a hot wok; fry garlic and chillies briefly without browning them too hard.
Add minced beef and stir-fry until evenly cooked. Add fish sauce, sugar and stock, reducing until glossy.
Turn off heat and fold in the basil so it remains aromatic.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Cook the rice and spread it shallowly for rapid cooling before packaging.

components.name: Egg
steps: Cook the three eggs separately. For multi-day prep, cook eggs fully rather than packing runny yolks.
Pack beef, rice and cooked egg. Add basil fresh after reheating where possible.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; quantities, macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Contains fish sauce — not shellfish/fish-free by default.
Freezer: Freeze beef; rice freezes if cooled promptly; egg texture suffers.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
